data.name: DefaultTitle
data.comment: The title of a public collection page when its owner hasn't written one.

data.comment: Heading of the plants on a public collection page, and in its link bar.

data.name: PartCuttings
data.comment: Heading of the cuttings on a public collection page.

data.comment: Heading of what is up for swap on a public collection page.

data.name: PartWishlist
data.comment: Heading of the wishlist on a public collection page.

data.name: Plants_One
data.comment: Under the title of a public collection page. {0} is the number.

data.name: Cuttings_One
data.comment: Under the title of a public collection page. {0} is the number.

data.name: Photo_One
data.comment: Under the name on the story of a plant or cutting. {0} is the number.

data.name: BackTo

data.name: Previous
data.comment: Link to the previous numbered page.

data.name: Next
data.comment: Link to the next numbered page.

data.name: PageOf
data.comment: Between the links to the previous and next page.

data.name: PageTitle

data.name: PartPageTitle
data.comment: The title of the browser tab on a part page. {0} is the part, like Cuttings, {1} is the title of the page.

data.name: Description
data.value: A plant collection kept in Stikling, a free app for your plants and cuttings.
data.comment: What a link to the page says when its owner hasn't written a line.

data.name: NothingYet

data.name: FooterAbout
data.value: Kept in Stikling, a free app for your plants and cuttings.
data.comment: Bottom of a public page.

data.name: StartYourOwn
data.comment: Button at the bottom of a public page.

data.name: LastUpdated
data.comment: Bottom of a public page. {0} is a date.

data.name: ReportPage
data.comment: Link at the bottom of a public page that writes an email.

data.name: ReportSubject
data.comment: The subject of the email to report a public page.

data.name: DateFormat
data.comment: A .NET date pattern, not text. The day, the short month and the year.

data.name: CompareWithMine
data.comment: Button on a public collection page that opens the app to compare the page's plants with the visitor's own list.
